title: vibecore-platform values — safety-critical keys only
description: Validates ONLY the keys whose silent loss has already caused (or would cause) a production incident. Everything else stays schema-free on purpose: this file must never make an unrelated upgrade fail. Helm validates the COALESCED values (chart defaults merged with the release's reused values) on every install/upgrade/template/lint.

imageDigest.description: Optional immutable global image digest. Production normally supplies a per-service digest; malformed values fail before rollout.
Per-service immutable digest from the verified release manifest.

imageSourceSha.description: Exact source commit persisted beside the digest for carried-forward provenance.

serverDeployRollbackFromDigest.description: D2 (approved 2026-07-17): '1' = server rollback re-deploys the retained image by digest (I-REL-1, fail-closed). '0' = explicit kill switch — the api refuses server rollbacks (409) rather than reviving the URL-copy row that re-deploys nothing. Any other value (including '' or a bare boolean) is rejected at upgrade time.

deploymentAccessActivationEnabled.description: P104 / SEC-8 two-phase activation interlock. '0' (chart default, fail-closed) = the api refuses to ACTIVATE deployment password protection (503 DEPLOYMENT_ACCESS_ACTIVATION_DISABLED); '1' = activation open. Enforcement of an already-protected deployment is never gated by this flag, and un-protecting (mode=public) stays allowed at '0'. Only deploy-main.yml sets '1', and only after the last pre-cutover pod is gone and its last public max-age=60 response has expired. Any other value (including '' or a bare boolean) is rejected at upgrade time.

reservedVmEnabled.description: Operator activation gate. Enabling also requires the dedicated Secret-backed payload keyring and live node-pool capability.

reservedVmPayloadEncryptionKeyId.description: Non-secret identifier for the active Reserved VM recovery-payload key. Key material stays in the Kubernetes Secret.
